description: This file defines a PHP class `I18NTranslationBulkAPI` within the OrangeHRM system. It provides an API endpoint for bulk updating internationalization (i18n) translations, specifically for language translation data. The class extends the Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, handling operations such as bulk update of translations with validation rules, transaction management, and integration with localization services.
